description: Run a Google News search from a chosen country and return news results. Supports desktop, mobile, iOS, and Android emulation and multi-page results.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to geo-target the request from (e.g. "US"). Use list_countries to see supported codes per model. Deprecated — use gl instead; country is kept for compatibility and must not disagree with gl.

device.description: Device to emulate: desktop, mobile, ios (Safari on iPhone), or android (Chrome on Android). mobile is an alias for android. Defaults to desktop.

gl.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code for the result geography, sent to Google as gl (e.g. "us"). Use list_countries to see supported codes per model.

hl.description: Optional Google interface-language code, sent as hl (e.g. "de", "pt-br"). Defaults to the language derived from gl — set it when the geography's dominant language is not the one you want.

include.description: Optional flag, off by default: html (the result page HTML). Leave unset for the leanest response.

pages.description: Number of result pages to fetch (1-10). Defaults to 1.

name: scrape_google_news
title: Scrape Google News
